# Od-Lagna — Re:Zero Tappei Q&A Archive

> Od-Lagna is a comprehensive, searchable archive indexing every public statement, event interview, and Twitter Q&A given by Re:Zero author Tappei Nagatsuki, featuring granular spoiler cutoff controls.

## Archive Structure

- [Home](https://od-lagna.pages.dev/): Overview of the archive, metrics, debut arc distributions, and quick navigation.
- [Browse Archive](https://od-lagna.pages.dev/browse): Full searchable database of over 4,200 Q&A and trivia entries. Supports multi-token search, typo tolerance, character filters, topic tags, and arc cutoff controls.
- [Character Profiles](https://od-lagna.pages.dev/characters): Character database detailing canon debut arcs, aliases, Japanese names, affiliations, and verified Q&A statements.
- [IF Routes Directory](https://od-lagna.pages.dev/ifs): Exploration of alternate-reality IF stories (Sloth IF, Greed IF, Pride IF, Wrath IF, Gluttony IF, Lust IF, etc.) and related Q&A supplements.
- [Side Stories Directory](https://od-lagna.pages.dev/side-stories): Index of store bonus booklets, monthly magazine novellas, and canon side stories.
- [Anime Episode Commentary](https://od-lagna.pages.dev/anime): Archive of over 4,000 broadcast live-tweets, behind-the-scenes trivia, and scene commentary by Tappei Nagatsuki across all television seasons (Season 1 to Season 4).
- [About](https://od-lagna.pages.dev/about): Methodology, verification criteria, and project philosophy.
- [Contribute](https://od-lagna.pages.dev/contribute): Contribution guidelines, submission templates, and verification standards.

## Key Features for Agents and Readers

- **Spoiler Protection**: Readers and automated systems can filter statements by story arc (Arc 1 through Arc 9) and independently allow or disallow IF routes to prevent spoilers.
- **Verification Levels**: Statements are categorized by verification level with primary source citations from author tweets, convention panels, and official fanbooks.
- **Search Capabilities**: Instant client-side fuzzy search indexing questions, author answers, aliases, and thematic tags.
